segments.en: I greatly exult in the heroic deeds of Hashem, in His immense wonders — that He performed with all Israel: that you were chosen through the merit and power of the Tzadik — after several years — to invest all… that you have merited to recognize and to see and to recognize and to cleave to the true Tzadik — the new light, who has revealed new awesome and wondrous lights beyond all reckoning — to teach true knowledge to every person in the world! May Hashem so continue His kindness — to save you forever.
